facts.fact: The World Bank blog says the Business Regulatory Reform unit put the MSME Classification Regulation (2021) on its Public Consultation Portal, where it drew over 1,000 views and suggestions, one of which was adopted in the final regulation.

The World Bank blog says Ghana's Business Regulatory Reform unit runs a Public Consultation Portal through which civil society accesses draft laws and regulatory proposals and BRR officials review comments and poll results.

systems.owner: Business Regulatory Reform unit, Ministry of Trade and Industry
